input: Find Boys & Girls Clubs, YWCA, community centers and recreation centers with summer camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville Salvation Army Boys Girls Club summer 2025

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 day and specialty camps for kids and teens at multiple city community centers.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Summer youth programming operated in 2026 at the club on Ashe Street.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach for children and teens; Camp Tikvah serves children with autism; 2027 camp announced.

candidates.name: Town of Waynesville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer Basecamp ran in 2026 through the Waynesville Recreation Center.

candidates.name: Town of Black Mountain Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Weekly June–August camps for rising first through sixth graders, with crafts, STEM and outings.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp included swimming, field trips, crafts, sports and nature activities.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.town: Asheville, Candler, Hendersonville and Bryson City
candidates.note: Regional day and half-day camps plus overnight Camp Watia; adventure programs include ages 9–15.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greater Spartanburg
candidates.note: Polk County summer day camp operated in 2026, with a counselor-in-training program for ages 13–15.
